description: Intel, on Tuesday, announced that it will join Elon Musk’s Terafab project, alongside SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI. The chipmaker said that it will bring its domain expertise in designing and fabricating processors to help the billionaire build and scale the aim of developing chipsets for humanoid robots and data centres. First announced in March, Terafab wants to produce more than one terawatt of compute per year.
title: Intel Joins Elon Musk’s Terafab Project to Build Chips for Humanoid Robots and Data Centres

description: A New York Times report has suggested that Adam Back could be Satoshi Nakamoto, citing similarities in writing style, technical ideas, and early cryptographic work. However, the claim remains unproven, with Back denying the allegations. The debate adds to ongoing speculation around Bitcoin’s anonymous creator.
title: British Cryptographer Adam Back Responds After Report Suggests He Might Be Bitcoin Creator 'Satoshi Nakamoto'

description: Vivo T5 Pro 5G will be launched in India with a price tag of under Rs. 37,000, a tipster claims. The top-of-the-line model, which will reportedly offer 12GB of RAM and 256GB of onboard storage, is said to be priced in the country at Rs. 36,999. Meanwhile, the base RAM and storage configuration could launch with a price tag of about Rs. 30,000. Separately, the Vivo T5 Pro 5G has reportedly been listed on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number V2568, hinting that the phone might ship with a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, Android 16, and 12GB of RAM.
title: Vivo T5 Pro 5G Price in India Leaked as New Geekbench Listing Reveals Key Specifications

description: Oppo Watch X3 Mini is all set to launch on April 21. The company is currently accepting pre-reservations for the upcoming wearable through its online store in China. It will be launched in High Gloss Gold, Mocha Brown and Starlight Silver (translated from Chinese) colour options. It will come with a sapphire crystal glass coating and an 18K gold and stainless steel case. The wearable will have sensors to track menstrual cycles, stress, and sleep, among others.
title: Oppo Watch X3 Mini Design, Health Tracking Features Revealed Days Before Launch in China

description: New results from COSINE-100 and ANAIS-112 show no signal matching the DAMA experiment claim, weakening evidence for dark matter detection and shifting focus toward new search strategies.
title: New Data From COSINE-100, ANAIS-112 Disputes DAMA Dark Matter Results

description: Anthropic, on Tuesday, announced Project Glasswing, a new initiative focused on artificial intelligence (AI)-powered cybersecurity. Powering the project for the San Francisco-based AI firm is a general-purpose model dubbed Claude Mythos Preview. The company introduces the model as its most capable when it comes to coding and agentic tasks.
title: Project Glasswing: Anthropic Debuts Claude Mythos Preview, Its First Cybersecurity-Focused AI Model

description: Currently, multiple brands like HP, Canon and Brother are selling feature-packed wireless laser printers in India. Some offer print, scan and copy functions and feature LCD panels. Here we have listed the best laser printers available in the market right now. Most of the models are available for purchase through Amazon.
title: Best Wireless Laser Printers Available in India Right Now

description: Cyberpunk 2077's free PS5 Pro update rolls out on April 8, CD Projekt Red has announced. The update brings support for PSSR and enhanced ray tracing. Cyberpunk 2077 also gets three modes on PS5 Pro: Ray Tracing Pro, Performance, and Ray Tracing.
title: Cyberpunk Gets Free PS5 Pro Update That Brings PSSR Support, Ray Tracing Enhancements

description: WhatsApp has started rolling out the usernames feature, allowing users to create unique usernames, according to a report. This is said to be a privacy and security measure, which will let users share their usernames instead of phone numbers with others. The feature is reportedly live on WhatsApp for Android and iOS apps. The instant messaging platform is said to be rolling out the feature in a phased manner. It is reportedly available for a limited number of users. The feature might appear in the profile settings section within the app.
title: WhatsApp Username Feature Reportedly Rolling Out to Some Users on iOS, Android

description: MSI Raider 18 Max HX has been launched in India as the latest gaming laptop from the Taiwanese tech giant. The new laptop has been unveiled in the country along with the new MSI Prestige 13 AI+ productivity laptop. The new Raider 18 Max HX is powered by an Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus processor. It is also equipped with the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 GPU. On the other hand, the MSI Prestige 13 AI+ is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 7 355 processor, paired with an integrated Intel Graphics GPU.
title: MSI Raider 18 Max HX Launched in India With Intel Core Ultra 9 Processor, MSI Prestige 13 AI+ Tags Along

description: Samsung announced Exynos 2600 as its latest flagship-grade mobile processor in December 2025. The 2nm in-house silicon currently powers the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+ models in India and other markets. While only a couple of months have passed since their debut, a new flagship chipset developed by Samsung Foundry has surfaced on a benchmarking site, revealing its moniker and performance figures. While the brand has yet to confirm the details, it could power the South Korean tech conglomerate’s 2027 flagship lineup.
title: Samsung Exynos 2700 Chip Reportedly Surfaces on Geekbench With 10-Core CPU, Xclipse 970 GPU

description: Coinbase has secured an Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL), paving the way to expand its crypto offerings in the country. The move comes ahead of new legislation mandating licences for exchanges. With rising crypto adoption in Australia, the development reflects growing regulatory clarity and institutional participation in the digital asset market.
title: Coinbase Plans to Expand Crypto Offerings in Australia After Securing Financial Services Licence

description: Redmi is gearing up to launch a new smartphone in China, which is expected to join the existing K90 and K90 Pro Max models. The Xiaomi sub-brand recently started teasing the handset via official renders on its social media handles, and its design has now been revealed ahead of its debut. Dubbed Redmi K90 Max, it is seen with an aluminium alloy frame and a relatively pronounced camera island on the rear.
title: Redmi K90 Max Design, Colourway Revealed Ahead of China Launch; Redmi K Pad 2 Also Teased

description: A hitman’s life takes a bizarre turn when a wasp sting turns him into a schoolboy in Kill Blue.
title: Kill Blue OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Anime Online?

description: Moto Pad (2026) has been launched in the US by the tech firm, along with the Moto G Stylus handset. The new tablet is slated to go on sale in the country on April 30 via various offline and online retail channels in a single Pantone-curated Bronze Green colourway and sole 8GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration. The new tablet appears to be the rebranded version of the Moto Pad 60 Neo, which was launched in India in September 2025. Both tablets share the key specifications, features, storage capacity, and colourway. The new Moto Pad (2026) sports an 11-inch 2.5K display.
title: Moto Pad (2026) Launched With 7,040mAh Battery, 11-Inch 2.5K Display: Price, Specifications

description: The FDIC has proposed new rules under the GENIUS Act to regulate stablecoin issuers in the US. The framework mandates full asset backing, audits, and stricter compliance standards. The move aims to improve trust and stability in the sector as institutions increasingly explore crypto-linked financial products.
title: FDIC Proposes to Regulate Stablecoin Issuers in the US Under the GENIUS Enactment

description: A new leak suggests that the design of the vanilla iPhone 18 will remain largely unchanged from the iPhone 17. This leak contradicts recent rumours about the iPhone 18 getting a smaller Dynamic Island. Apple is said to follow its previous launch pattern for the iPhone Air 2. Therefore, we can expect the iPhone Air 2 to go official in the fall alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and Apple's rumoured foldable iPhone.
title: iPhone 18 Said to Retain Same Design as Predecessor, iPhone Air 2 Launch Timeline Tipped

description: Sony has announced a new community initiative through which PlayStation fans could win a chance to be scanned and put inside a PS5 game, starting with Gran Turismo 7. Applications for the Playerbase contest are now live. One selected fan will be scanned and put inside Gran Turismo 7 for a limited time later this year.
title: Sony Announces Playerbase Program to Scan Fans' Faces and Put Them in PlayStation Games

description: Moto G Stylus (2026) was launched in the US and Canadian markets on Tuesday. It arrives as the successor to the Moto G Stylus (2025), which was announced in April 2025. As the name suggests, the standout features on the handset is the built-in active stylus. The company claims it can respond to tilt and pressure in supported apps, enabling broader shading and finer lines. The Moto G Stylus (2026) sports a 6.7‑inch Extreme AMOLED screen. It packs a 5,200mAh battery.
title: Moto G Stylus (2026) Launched With Built-In Active Stylus and Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Written and directed by Karthik Yogi, Vadakkupatti Ramaswamy is a rural Tamil comedy-drama film that is now finally hitting the digital screens.
title: Vadakkupatti Ramaswamy Out on OTT: Know Where to Watch This Tamil Comedy Drama Online

description: India has reached a significant milestone in its nuclear programme. On Tuesday, the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR) attained first criticality, an important stage where the reactor generates more fuel than it burns. Now that the PFBR is capable of sustained nuclear chain reaction, the programme will move towards the next stage, where it will use India’s vast reserves of Thorium.
title: India’s Native Fast Breeder Reactor Reaches First Criticality: 5 Things to Know

description: Oppo is gearing up to launch two new members of the Find X9 family this month. While the Oppo Find X9 Ultra will be introduced in the global markets, the Find X9s Pro will be limited to China. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the latter has been discovered on a benchmarking site, which reveals its model number and some of its key specifications. The Oppo Find X9s Pro is expected to arrive with a flagship Dimensity chipset and run Android 16.
title: Oppo Find X9s Pro With Dimensity 9500 Chip, 16GB RAM Visits Geekbench Ahead of China Launch

description: Hades 2, Vampire Crawlers, Kiln are joining Xbox Game Pass in the first half of April. The three games will join the service as day one titles. Microsoft announced the first wave of titles coming to Game Pass this month on Tuesday. Other games coming to the service include Replaced, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, DayZ, Planet Coaster 2, The Thaumaturge, among others.
title: Xbox Game Pass Wave 1 Titles for April Announced: Hades 2, Vampire Crawlers, Kiln and More

description: Keeper is a 2025 Folk Horror Film that is now available to stream exclusively on Amazon Prime Video. The film is terrifying and explores themes of toxic romance and survival.
title: Keeper Out on OTT: Know Everything About This Folk Horror Film Online

description: Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2 and Active 3 Premium smartwatches have been launched in India with AMOLED displays and Bluetooth calling support. The Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2 has a 1.5-inch AMOLED display, while the Amazfit Active 3 Premium sports a 1.32-inch AMOLED display. Both models have sensors to monitor heart rate, blood-oxygen saturation (SpO2) levels, stress and sleep. The Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2 offers 187 sports modes, while the Active 3 Premium has over 170 sports modes.
title: Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2, Amazfit Active 3 Premium Launched in India With AMOLED Screens, Bluetooth Calling Support: Price, Features

description: Google is rolling out two new features for its Chrome browser. Google has added vertical tabs to Chrome.  This feature can be enabled by right-clicking on any Chrome window and selecting Show Tabs Vertically. Additionally, Google Chrome's Reading Mode is getting a new full-page interface. This can be accessed by right-clicking on any page and selecting Open in reading mode. This feature transforms the webpage into a text-focused one.
title: Google Chrome Updated With Vertical Tabs Feature and Full Page Reading Mode

description: NASA’s Artemis 2 mission has now set its sights on Earth after the successful completion of the lunar flyby. During the flyby, the crew set a new record for the maximum distance travelled by a human from the Earth. They also observed the far side of the lunar surface and had the opportunity to witness a rare solar eclipse as well.
title: Artemis 2 Mission Starts Return Trip to Earth After Historic Lunar Flyby

description: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island is a reality drama series from Bravo’s popular franchise.
title: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island Now Streaming Online: Cast, Plot, Where to Watch, and More

description: To understand its inner workings and vision in the AI space, Gadgets 360 recently had an exclusive interaction with Dr. Manish Gupta, Senior Director, Research, Google DeepMind. The conversation delved into DeepMind’s journey after its acquisition by Google, its biggest milestones, and the impact of the India team on the global division.
title: AI That Solves for India Can Solve for the World: Google DeepMind's Manish Gupta

description: WhatsApp has started rolling out a new update for iPhone models, which brings the new WhatsApp for CarPlay app to connected vehicle infotainment systems. The company posted a new event on Apple’s App Store, calling it a “Major Update” for the release of WhatsApp for iOS version 26.13.74, which includes the WhatsApp for CarPlay functionality. The update is currently available for download in select global markets, including India. The standalone WhatsApp for CarPlay app brings the ability to check the chat and call history, which are displayed in separate tabs.
title: WhatsApp for CarPlay Launched With Support for Initiating WhatsApp Calls and Separate Chat, Call History Tabs

description: Vivo T5 Pro 5G is set to launch in India next month, Vivo confirmed in a X post and media invite on Wednesday. The upcoming Vivo T series smartphone will be available for purchase in India through Flipkart. The Vivo T5 Pro 5G is confirmed to come with a Snapdragon chipset and a large battery. It will offer an AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution. The Vivo T5 Pro 5G is expected to succeed last year's Vivo T4 Pro 5G.
title: Vivo T5 Pro 5G India Launch Date Announced; Teased to Come With 9,020mAh Battery

description: Oppo F33 series will be launched in India on April 15, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. The upcoming lineup will include two smartphones, dubbed Oppo F33 5G and Oppo F33 Pro 5G. On top of this, the company has revealed the design of the new smartphones, along with a few specifications, features, and colour options. The Oppo F33 Pro 5G will be equipped with a dual rear camera unit, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter. The Pro model is confirmed to be offered in India in Misty Forest, Starry Blue, and Passion Red colour options.
title: Oppo F33 Pro 5G and Oppo F33 5G  India Launch Date Announced as Company Reveals Design, Colour Options

description: Bitcoin traded above $71,000 on Wednesday as easing geopolitical tensions triggered a relief rally across global markets. Strong ETF inflows and short liquidations supported the move, while analysts noted that institutional participation remains uneven. Altcoins posted gains, but investors are closely watching upcoming inflation data for confirmation of further upside.
title: Bitcoin Surges Above $71,000 as Easing Geopolitical Tensions Lift Crypto Market Sentiment

description: Motorola is said to have increased the prices of several of its smartphones in India. According to a tipster, multiple models have received a price hike across storage variants. The Motorola Edge 60 Fusion, launched in April 2025, is now allegedly priced Rs. 2,000 higher across all storage variants. The price hike is also tipped to affect several Moto G-series models, too. With the alleged move, Motorola becomes the latest brand to bring about a price revision in the country.
title: Motorola Edge 60 Fusion, Moto G57 Power and G35 Price in India Hiked, Tipster Claims

description: Google announced a new set of AI-powered shopping features in India on Tuesday. The Mountain View-based tech giant is integrating its Gemini models with the extensive Shopping Graph, with the aim of simplifying product discovery. Updates have been introduced across the Gemini app, AI Mode in Search, and Circle to Search to help users browse, compare, and purchase products more efficiently. The company also noted that its Shopping Graph now includes over 50 billion products, with nearly 2 billion listings updated every hour.
title: Google Improves AI-Powered Shopping Experience in India With Gemini, Search, and Circle to Search Updates

description: Apple’s first foldable smartphone, which is expected to be called the iPhone Fold, will be launched later this year, in September, according to a report citing people with knowledge of the matter. The handset will be launched by the Cupertino-based tech giant along with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, the report added. The latest development rebuts earlier reports that claimed that the production of the iPhone Fold is facing delays due to engineering challenges. The trial production for the handset has reportedly commenced, too.
title: Apple’s First Foldable Reportedly on Track for September Launch Despite Claims of Production Delays

description: The OnePlus Nord 6 has been launched in India, and the new smartphone from the London-based tech firm is set to compete with other mid-range handsets, like the Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G and the Nothing Phone 4a Pro. The new OnePlus Nord 6 is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, which outperforms the SoCs on the Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G and the Nothing Phone 4a Pro. Similarly, the handset also packs the largest battery, rated at a 9,000mAh battery capacity amoing the lot.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 vs Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G vs Nothing Phone 4a Pro: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared
